```{r}
rm(list = ls())

base_dir <- "~/Desktop/sequencing/2025_11_Plasmidsuarus_RNA_Seq"
code_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "sorelle-lab-ezh2-project")
data_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "data")
fastq_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "fastq")
ref_genome <- file.path(data_dir, "ref_genome/hg38_NC007605_genome.fa")
pipe_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "pipeline")
out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "outputs")
setwd(code_dir)

source('functions.R')

using('BiocManager', 'dplyr', 'tidyr', 'ggplot2')
bioc_using('Rsubread', 'edgeR', 'biomaRt', 'org.Hs.eg.db')

```

```{r reference index}
## not needed if starting with count matrix
# index with human & EBV genome
buildindex(basename='hg38_ebv1', reference=ref_genome)
```


```{r diff cell lines}
cell_lines <- c('akata', 'cf5', 'lcl', 'ibl1', 'mutu')

for (x in cell_lines){
  fit <- edger_degs(x)
  comparisons <- c('2v1', '3v1', '3v2')
  for (y in comparisons){
    edger_volcano_plot(fit, x, y)
  }
}

```
